payload.intro: I keep an extensive, rather exhausting ledger of adventurers who panic and misclick their prayers.
payload.prompt: Which Mor Ul Rek monster sends mortals to my desk with a single 97-damage strike?

payload.intro: Many fearful mortals try to cheat me of their company with one irritating piece of jewellery.
payload.prompt: Which ring teleports you away when your health drops below 10%?

payload.intro: When your fragile mortal frame collapses, I generously set a timer on your gravestone before I haul your mess to my office.
payload.prompt: How many minutes does a gravestone last?

payload.intro: I keep a special, pristine registry for mortals who boast that they will never make a foolish mistake.
payload.prompt: What colour helmet does a Hardcore Ironman wear?

payload.intro: Some especially spiteful adventurers choose to depart this world with an explosive burst of divine wrath.
payload.prompt: Which level 46 Prayer damages nearby enemies when you die?

payload.intro: Mortals spend millions of coins on ancient scrolls from the Chambers of Xeric just to bolster their defences.
payload.prompt: At what Prayer level do you unlock Augury?

payload.intro: I run a very fair business. Sacrifice tradeable equipment into my Coffer, and I credit it against future fees.
payload.prompt: What percentage of an item's Grand Exchange guide price does my Coffer credit?

payload.intro: Most mortals who cross my threshold immediately start weeping about their precious fourth item. Spare me the whining.
payload.prompt: At what Prayer level do you unlock Protect Item?

payload.intro: Deep in level 38 of the Wilderness lies an unholy altar where many reckless mortals have met their end offering bones.
payload.prompt: Which god's temple holds the bone altar in level 38 of the Wilderness?

payload.intro: Some mortals try to bargain with me at the very last moment.
payload.prompt: Which prayer trades all your prayer points for hitpoints when you drop below 10% health?
